report_metadata.project: ManuMind AI — Explainable Multi-Agent AI System for Manufacturing Anomaly Detection and Root Cause Analysis
report_metadata.institution: Department of AI & Data Science, RMK Engineering College
report_metadata.milestone: Phase 5 Step 4.2 — Anomaly Agent Audit-Condition Remediation

COND-1.title: Downstream Failure Masking via AnomalyExecutionStatus and Status-Aware Supervisor Routing
actions_taken: Introduced explicit AnomalyExecutionStatus Enum with SUCCESS, FAILED, and INSUFFICIENT_DATA members in backend/app/agents/enums.py.
Exported AnomalyExecutionStatus in backend/app/agents/__init__.py.
Added execution_status: AnomalyExecutionStatus field to AnomalyDetectionResult and AnomalyAssessment schemas in backend/app/agents/schemas.py.
Added Pydantic validator validate_assessment_invariants in AnomalyAssessment enforcing that FAILED and INSUFFICIENT_DATA runs cannot assert anomaly_detected=True and must have anomaly_type=NONE.
Updated AnomalyDetectionAgent.analyze() to emit execution_status=INSUFFICIENT_DATA on missing/invalid telemetry and FAILED on inference exceptions.

Updated SupervisorAgent.evaluate() with status-aware routing: FAILED routes to FAIL_WORKFLOW, INSUFFICIENT_DATA routes to ESCALATE_TO_HUMAN_GATE, SUCCESS with anomaly routes to ROUTE_TO_ROOT_CAUSE_ANALYSIS, and SUCCESS without anomaly routes to COMPLETE_WORKFLOW (only if assessment is valid and confidence > 0.0).
Added 8 dedicated COND-1 regression tests in backend/tests/test_supervisor_agent.py verifying failure and insufficient data routing paths.

COND-2.title: Pressure Baseline Operational Envelope Alignment with Training Distribution
actions_taken: Analyzed real training data distribution in data/processed/sensor_train.csv (N=24,500 normal records: mean=6.2023 bar, std=0.1211 bar, 3-sigma=[5.8388, 6.5657] bar, min=5.7100 bar, max=6.6700 bar).
Identified fault regimes: pressure drop in M107 drops by up to 3.8 bar to 2.4 bar; overheating in M102 rises by up to 1.9 bar to 8.1 bar.
Updated DEFAULT_BASELINE_RANGES['pressure'] from contradictory [1.0, 4.5] to operational envelope {'min': 5.0, 'max': 7.5} bar in backend/app/agents/anomaly_agent.py.
Updated MockInferenceService heuristic check to evaluate pressure < 5.0 or pressure > 7.5.
Updated test fixtures in backend/tests/test_anomaly_agent.py to use nominal 6.2 bar pressure.
Added pressure baseline envelope test verifying nominal 6.2 bar, low 3.5 bar drop, high 8.2 bar overpressure, and boundary values 5.0 and 7.5 bar.

COND-3.title: Agent Scope and Sequence Reconstruction Documentation Rectification
actions_taken: Updated module and class docstrings in backend/app/agents/anomaly_agent.py explicitly declaring that AnomalyDetectionAgent performs point-in-time tabular anomaly detection using Isolation Forest.
Documented that 30-step temporal sequence reconstruction with LSTM Autoencoder is deferred to a future dedicated temporal-anomaly triage node.
Removed misleading dead constant LSTM_AUTOENCODER_FROZEN_THRESHOLD from anomaly_agent.py without touching or deleting any underlying model weights or artifacts in ml/models_store/.

COND-4.title: Real Model Artifact Integration and Kernel SHAP Verification Without Mocks
actions_taken: Authored backend/tests/test_anomaly_agent_integration.py containing 6 integration tests executing the real UnifiedInferenceService and real model artifacts.
Test 1: Verified real sensor_scaler.joblib and isolation_forest.joblib load via ModelRegistry without mocks and match verified SHA-256 hashes.
Test 2: Verified StandardScaler transforms valid 5-channel vector preserving canonical feature ordering [vibration, temperature, pressure, current, rpm].
Test 3: Verified real Isolation Forest predicts continuous score and is_anomaly boolean flag.
Test 4: Verified real Kernel SHAP generates game-theoretic feature attribution satisfying additivity axiom (additivity_verified=True, error < 1e-16).
Test 5: Verified real AnomalyDetectionAgent evaluates shared state using real UnifiedInferenceService without mocks, returning SUCCESS status and SHAP metadata.
Test 6: Verified missing model artifact produces explicit FAILED status and triggers FAIL_WORKFLOW routing in SupervisorAgent, never classifying equipment as healthy.
